g.text: Two ways to get locking wrong
each holds what the other wants
Nobody runs, nobody fails: both blocked, 0% CPU, forever.
Cure: every thread takes the locks in the same order.
time of check to time of use: the answer went stale
Every access is under the lock, and the result is still wrong:
one item, two buyers, stock at -1.
Cure: check and act inside one critical section.
